purpose: camera test aid: com.apple.camera's CAMUserPreferenceCaptureDevice set to 0 (back, automatic) and CAMUserPreferenceCaptureMode to 0 (Photo), so that the next start of Camera.app asks for the back camera (the dual-wide device) at once instead of the front one it was left on (run q10hk never got to the back cameras). The values that were there are kept in com.apple.camera.plist.pre-camback (a small plist). Undo: guest-camback-undo.sh.
